description: Percussion synthesizer joining the FM engine of Opulus to the drum envelopes of Trummor 2: an oscillator section and a noise section, each a carrier and a modulator with its own pitch and gate input

params.text: Sets the pitch of that section, over 24 semitones up and down
Sets the pitch the oscillator section starts from
Sets the decay time of the pitch envelope of the oscillator section
Selects one of eight waveforms for the carrier of that section
Sets the frequency multiplier of that section's modulator, from 0.5 to 16 times
Sets the decay of that section's modulator envelope
Sets the rising rate of that section's envelope
Sets the time that section's envelope stays at its maximum
Sets the rate at which that section's envelope falls
Sets the level of that section's carrier, which is the volume of the section
Sets the level of that section's modulator
Sets the feedback of both operators in the noise section, and raising it makes them generate noise
Sends the noise section through a resonator, which adds a small reverb-like character
Shapes the tonality of that section with a pair of low and high shelf filters
Picks that section's envelope: AHD for attack, hold and decay, or ASR, which holds while the gate stays high
Attenuates and inverts the modulation input of the same number before it reaches the control assigned to that slot
Assigns that modulation slot: press it, then move the control the slot should change

inputs.text: A gate that triggers both sections
Sets the pitch of the oscillator section, 1V per octave
Sets the pitch of the noise section, 1V per octave
A control voltage for the control assigned to the modulation slot of the same number
A gate that triggers the oscillator section on its own
A gate that triggers the noise section on its own

outputs.text: The audio of the oscillator section on its own
The audio of the noise section on its own

notes: a modulation input does nothing until its slot is assigned: press the slot's button, then move the control the slot should change
30 factory drums ship with the module and are loaded from the preset list in the right-click menu: kicks, snares, toms, percussion and a split hat
menu: Rand. Oscillator — lets the randomize command touch the oscillator section: tune, bend, time, wave, mult, tone, FM level, its envelope and its level
Rand. Noise — lets the randomize command touch the noise section: tune, feed, body, wave, mult, tone, FM level, its envelope and its level
Rand. Modulation — lets the randomize command touch the amounts of the four modulation slots
